idea-plugin.name: SQL Dialect for Trino
idea-plugin.description:
A real Trino SQL dialect for DataGrip and IntelliJ-family IDEs. Stock IDEs treat Trino/Presto/Athena as generic data sources with the Generic SQL editor; this plugin gives Trino SQL first-class treatment, validated by Trino's own parser (io.trino:trino-parser, bundled, version 483).

  • Measured coverage: 150/150 syntax families (490 statements) from Trino's own repository at tag 483 parse clean — SQL routines, MATCH_RECOGNIZE, PIVOT, JSON clause functions, GRANT/DENY, prepared statements and more.
  • Engine-exact errors, zero setup: the bundled trino-parser validates every statement — Trino's own grammar, exact positions, no server needed.
  • Function completion: 442 functions (kind icons, return types) harvested from Trino 483, plus its 83 reserved words.
  • Schema tree that fills in as you type: connectors appear as catalogs on connect; drilling into a catalog or schema during completion introspects just that namespace, one level at a time — so a huge hive/iceberg catalog is never bulk-loaded. Query cancel verified client- and server-side.
  • Trino auth & TLS built in: no-TLS uses sessionUser (User field; Trino refuses passwords without TLS — leave Password empty). For HTTPS, enable TLS on the SSH/SSL tab (add your CA there for a private CA) — it maps to trino-jdbc's real SSL settings and User & Password auth just works.

Built on the architecture of our SQL Dialect for Apache Doris and SQL Dialect for DuckDB plugins.

This is an independent, community plugin developed by Sortdev SRL, not affiliated with the Trino Software Foundation. "Trino" is a trademark of the Trino Software Foundation, used only to identify the query engine this plugin supports.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — first public release.
  • Trino dialect with correct statement/run-block boundaries — coverage measured against Trino's own repository at tag 483: 150/150 sampled syntax families (490 statements), zero degraded shapes.
  • Engine-exact error checking by the bundled trino-parser 483 (Trino's own grammar; exact line/column; works with no data source configured).
  • Function completion: 442 functions with kind icons + 83 reserved words, harvested from Trino 483.
  • Schema tree via the generic JDBC introspector (deliberately forced — Trino's version number would otherwise select the PostgreSQL introspector against a server with no pg_catalog); connectors appear as catalogs, and completion deepens the tree lazily one namespace at a time as you type.
  • Data sources with Trino's auth model built in: no-TLS uses sessionUser (User field), never a password; TLS is enabled from the SSH/SSL tab (CA-cert aware) and mapped to trino-jdbc's own SSL settings. Official trino-jdbc 483 pinned, auto-downloaded from Maven Central.
